summary: Practise rail corridor modelling, track geometry review and renewal planning with OpenRail Designer. Explore the five-day course and outline.
lede: Railway infrastructure planning and track maintenance connects corridor models with track condition and renewal decisions. It is for rail design engineers, maintenance planners and asset professionals who need to turn survey and inspection information into maintainable work. You will practise creating and checking alignments, assessing track geometry, reviewing corridor interfaces and prioritising renewal work packages using OpenRail Designer.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who develop, check or maintain railway track assets and need to link OpenRail Designer models with field condition and renewal decisions.
modules: Rail Corridor Planning in OpenRail Designer
Track Survey Data and Model Checks
prerequisites: Working knowledge of railway track engineering, track maintenance or rail corridor design is expected. Familiarity with CAD or civil design software is useful. No programming is required. Hands-on OpenRail Designer activities require access to a compatible licensed installation; confirm software access and workstation requirements before the course.
